title: Quietly Comforting Irish Lamb Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful Irish dish featuring tender lamb, rich mascarpone, and the warmth of tandoor spices, all in a soothing and anti-inflammatory friendly broth. This stew is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tandoor spice blend, turmeric, and ginger, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the mascarpone cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
